sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Linden (Tilia sp.) contains flavonoids, terpenoids, p-coumaric acid, galactomannan mucilage, oligomeric procyanidins, and epicatechin. Linden volatile oils contain citral, citronellal, citronellol, eugenol, and limonene. Linden has been used by some women in Türkiye to increase milk supply or to improve the flavor of their milk; however, no scientifically valid clinical trials support these uses. Galactogogues should never replace evaluation and counseling on modifiable factors that affect milk production. Linden is “generally recognized as safe” (GRAS) in foods by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
